question: Is the historical real Feishu 230028 reproduction, official SDK/API contract, and focused coverage sufficient without deliberately triggering a new tenant content-policy rejection?
rationale: A fresh DLP rejection depends on tenant policy and potentially sensitive content, so automation cannot safely determine whether repeating it adds enough value to justify the operational cost.

options.title: Accept contract-backed proof
options.body: Treat the historical reproduction plus documented 230028 contract, pinned SDK propagation, focused tests, and refreshed exact-merge CI as sufficient.

options.title: Require fresh tenant proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a redacted live Feishu transcript or gateway log demonstrates the neutral notice after an actual 230028 rejection.

options.title: Narrow to classification first
options.body: Land only the classifier and defer user-visible fallback sequencing until a live rejection environment is available.

recommendation.title: Accept contract-backed proof
recommendation.body: Treat the historical reproduction plus documented 230028 contract, pinned SDK propagation, focused tests, and refreshed exact-merge CI as sufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the documented Feishu area owner, current assignee, and author of the implementation and validation rationale.
